text:
This is a highly recommended veterinary clinic for dog and cat owners. The vet is lovely and answers all questions. The treatment costs are clearly explained and not expensive, unlike other veterinary clinics in the San Sai area that try to push you with advanced diagnostic equipment, making the cost exorbitant and even more expensive than human treatment for the same illness.
It's good that there are more clinics like this for animal lovers in these times of high living costs.

The clinic is located opposite the Chedi Mae Krua market.
From Chedi Mae Krua market, head towards Phrao. Take the first U-turn after passing the market. Drive straight past the temple, and you'll find a small alley on the left with the Muang Thai Quick Loan building at the entrance.

Appointments are required for spaying/neutering dogs and cats.
